0.content: Varka, Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, led the Knights who destroyed the bandit gang that raised Rosaria. He judged its youngest member redeemable, brought her to Mondstadt and urged her to be cleansed by the Archon's light and live a normal life. She skipped every class instead and found her own darker work, but she stayed. She calls him long-winded and an old man who nags, yet admits he truly cares for people. He even wrote her birthday on her resume. Varka refuses to talk about her behind her back ("There's ice in that glare of hers") and says she should be ready to tell the Traveler about her past by now.

1.comment: Rosaria: The Bandits and the Cryo Vision
1.content: Rosaria was born in a remote mountain village and taken shortly after birth by the bandits who slaughtered it. She grew up as their servant, tool and thief, fighting outsiders and comrades alike to survive hunger and cold. One frigid night, starving, she ran away. The elder who had stolen her and taught her to kill brought her back and threw her an old dagger: a traitor could only earn freedom by winning a fight. Against all expectation she killed him, and her Cryo Vision appeared. The bandits, who had first resented her, accepted her in his place, reasoning that a Vision-bearer was stronger and ate less.

2.comment: Rosaria: Church of Favonius and the Sisters
2.content: Rosaria is the Church's number one truant. She skips mass, choir and ceremonies, smokes in the rearmost pew if she enters the Cathedral at all, and is the first to leave when cornered. As a novice she never attended a compulsory class and told her superiors she did not intend to work for the Church, having "found other work". Yet she has never faced serious consequences, because the Church covertly sanctions that other work. Sister Victoria, the senior sister who assigns her tasks and takes roll, is the one she most wants to avoid, and she suspects Victoria set Barbara to watch her.

3.content: Barbara is the one colleague who keeps trying to reach Rosaria: no smoking in the Cathedral, please arrive on time, come back, I'm still talking to you. Rosaria calls her a thorn in her side. In 1.2 Barbara chased her to Dragonspine for a commemorative choir event; Rosaria told her she was too trusting and sent her back in time for it. Barbara admits she lacks the courage to really talk to her, but is sure she believes in the Anemo Archon.

4.content: Dahlia covered Rosaria's turn answering the congregation's letters while she was away for days on an investigation. She returned with stains that might have been blood, passed on Victoria's job offer, and watched him flee. Now they are close. He says she was closed-off at first, but once he could catch her every time she vanished, she agreed to a mutually beneficial arrangement. She likes that he always pays and knows which questions to avoid. Since they figured each other out, she no longer needs to be guarded with him.

5.comment: Rosaria: Kaeya, Diluc and Angel's Share
5.content: Rosaria and Kaeya are drinking companions who trade information at Angel's Share, and she claims wine lets her see through his smooth talk. Kaeya keeps her secrets and says she is honest with herself. She thinks Diluc is confident, discreet and a little dangerous; Diluc calls her "no ordinary sister", and she answers that he is hardly a run-of-the-mill businessman. During Windblume (1.4, limited) Kaeya nearly attacked a suspicious figure near Knights Headquarters before realising it was Rosaria.

6.content: During the 3.1 Weinlesefest event (limited), Rosaria found Razor gathering wine ingredients to understand his parents. She recognised Varka's style in his swordplay and said they were something like brother and sister. When Razor asked about her parents, she said she barely remembers hers and asked what difference it would make if his turned out to be saints or monsters. Sunny Mondstadters, she said, could not tell him the hard truth. Then she gave him a Mist Flower whose cold she had dealt with, as the Church's contribution and to repay Varka. Razor said her words were cold and stung, but cold is good for wounds. He later listed the "cold lady" among the people who had done so much for him.

7.content: In Albedo's Story Quest (1.2) Rosaria tracked his footprints on Dragonspine, sensing elemental traces, and secretly watched his experiments on the Traveler. She then confronted them: taking orders from a stranger and drinking anonymous potions was rash. She inspected the site, copied the strange symbols, recommended patrols, and judged the Traveler no immediate threat, which spared her overtime. She warned them not to trust Albedo so quickly.

8.content: Rosaria finds the bard Venti "extremely interesting": something makes him different from other Mondstadters, and she cannot work out what. She does not know he is Barbatos, and she routinely gets the Archon's name wrong ("Barsibato? Bartobas?"). In a 5.4 anecdote they shared drinks outside The Cat's Tail. Venti thanked her for answering his "prayer" with a bottle, and she toasted the Anemo Archon "to every free life, lived under the sun".
